name: Rau rừng
summary: Rau rừng is forest greens, boiled or in soup, with the seafood rice. On 3 March 2026 the greens rau dớn, rau sân, rau lủi, and mã đề are still dipped in mắm cái with chili and garlic. By 2025, mắm cái is among foods people rarely use.
origin: Cham Islands. Forest and garden greens on Tân Hiệp, eaten with the catch.
howToEat: In soup, or boiled, with the midday or evening rice. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00 on the 16 September 2025 study.
More than 16 leaves, among them rau dớn, rau sân, rau lủi, and mã đề, are boiled and dipped in mắm cái with chili and garlic. On 16 September 2025, mắm cái is among foods people rarely use.
seoTitle: Rau rừng — island greens, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Forest greens in soup or boiled, with the seafood rice on Tân Hiệp. They are still dipped in mắm cái, and that sauce is also among foods people rarely use.
